audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Urgot levels 2 through First item while every 'why' string describes an even or K'Sante-favoured lane, and the packet chart plus the 51.5% Emerald+ win rate over 466 games say otherwise.
audit.why: Urgot's Corrosive Charge (Q) outranges Ntofo Strikes 800 to 450 at level 1, but from level 3 K'Sante's W stun into terrain plus the 2-stack Ntofo shockwave beats a champion whose only escape, Disdain (E), is on 16s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Urgot / Skill / K'Sante / K'Sante / Skill / Skill / Skill, matching the packet chart and the existing whys; difficulty lowered from 7.5 to 5.5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes described Urgot's abilities only as 'Q shotgun legs' and 'R fear-execute' with no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Corrosive Charge is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, Disdain 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s. Those numbers make the spike advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name Corrosive Charge, the Ntofo Strikes shockwave, Disdain and Fear Beyond Death with real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text claimed K'Sante's W charge is 'unstoppable' and could ignore Disdain's lockdown, and it never mentioned that Disdain shields Urgot as he charges. Urgot's ability names were absent entirely; 'Ntofo Strike' was written for Ntofo Strikes.
audit.why: Riot's text for K'Sante's W says only that he 'charges up, taking reduced damage' — unstoppable is not stated anywhere in the kit and must not be asserted. Disdain's text is explicit that Urgot 'charges in a direction, shielding himself', which is the burst-absorb the missing-interactions file flags for this matchup.
audit.corrected: W is described as damage reduction, not unstoppable. Disdain's shield is stated and the advice is to bait it before committing. All five Urgot abilities are named; Ntofo Strikes corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown advice named Disdain but never gave its duration.
audit.why: 16s at rank 1 is the punish window that defines the lane.
audit.corrected: Disdain's 16s is now stated in mid, wants.you and breakdown.difficulty.

edits.before: Urgot owns Level 1 — his Q shotgun legs out-range your single Ntofo Strike and his passive autos chunk you while you have zero engage, so just last-hit at the tip of Q and eat a little chip. Do NOT walk up to trade a single Q against him; he wins that exchange every time. Things flip at Level 3 once your Q-W combo is online: W-charge into him to smash him against the wall for the long stun, then land Q3 for the knock-up. That charge is also your answer to his slow — bank a couple of these clean trades and the lane is yours.
edits.after: Urgot owns Level 1 — Corrosive Charge (Q) reaches 800 to your Ntofo Strikes' 450 and Echoing Flames autos chunk you while you have zero engage, so last-hit at the tip of Q and eat a little chip. Do NOT walk up to trade single Qs; he wins that exchange every time. It flips at Level 3 once Q-W is online: W-charge him into the wall for the stun, then the 2-stack Ntofo shockwave pulls him back in. W's charge also cuts the damage of his return trade — bank two clean ones and the lane is yours.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your control window — you trade around his Q-leg cooldowns and your bulk eats his percent chip far better than he eats your sustained DPS. The danger is his E flip: if he flips you into his Q-W shotgun field, his percent-max-HP melts your big health bar, so save W's unstoppable charge to ignore the flip's lockdown. At 6 respect his R — the fear plus execute is a real kill threat. Your All Out wins the straight duel against many bruisers, but it strips your tankiness, so only flip the 1v1 when his R is down or you're topped up.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your control window — trade around Corrosive Charge's 10s cooldown and your bulk eats his chip better than he eats your sustained DPS. The danger is Disdain (E), 16s at rank 1: it shields him as he charges and hurls you into Purge range, where percent-max-HP melts your health bar. Bait it, then commit — your W stun and the Ntofo pull both land while it is down. At 6 respect Fear Beyond Death, 100s at rank 1; All Out wins the straight duel but strips your resists, so only flip the 1v1 when his R is down or you're topped up.

edits.before: Bait his E flip or R, survive it with W's unstoppable charge, then peel him with R All Out
edits.after: Bait out Disdain (E) — 16s at rank 1 — then land W's stun and the Ntofo pull while it is down

edits.before: Land E flip to lock you in his Q-W field where his percent-HP damage shreds your stacked HP
edits.after: Land Disdain (E), shielded as he charges, to dump you in Purge range where percent-HP shreds you
